{
  "premises": [
    {
      "statement": "Per-campaign open rate should be calculated from the delivery flag rather than the open flag.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "marts.marketo__operational_health_simple.campaign_summary",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "AVG(CASE WHEN was_delivered THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS open_rate",
      "alternative": "The contract specifies \"open rate = average of opened (as percent)\", supporting use of was_opened.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "This changes campaign health counts, the composite score, and potentially the recommendation.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "The chosen point allocations and thresholds implement the required composite health score.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "marts.marketo__operational_health_simple.overall_health_score",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "Deliverability, engagement, and campaign mix each receive 25, 20, 15, or 5 points, while stability receives 25, 15, or 5 points.",
      "alternative": "The contract describes an \"integer 35–100\" score but does not establish these particular thresholds or allocations; the implemented allocations permit a total of 20.",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "Unestablished scoring rules can materially change the snapshot's principal summary metric.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Every matched email-send row has a non-null activity_id.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "marts.marketo__operational_health_simple.lead_summary",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE activity_id IS NULL) AS inactive_leads; CASE WHEN activity_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ... END",
      "alternative": "The contract defines inactive leads as \"rows with no matching send\", while the email-sends contract explicitly guarantees non-null email_send_id rather than activity_id.",
      "importance": 3,
      "reason": "A matched send with a null activity identifier would be classified as inactivity and lose its engagement score.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "No email sends have future timestamps that would enter the recent-period metrics.",
      "about": "data",
      "target": "marts.marketo__operational_health_simple recent-delivery and seven-day trend metrics",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "activity_timestamp>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL 30 DAY; activity_date>=CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL 6 DAY",
      "alternative": "The contract describes activity \"over the last 30 days\" and \"within the last 7 days\", which supports excluding activity after the snapshot time.",
      "importance": 3,
      "reason": "Without upper bounds, future records can change recent delivery rates and trend averages.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "The last-seven-days trend window consists of today and the preceding six calendar dates.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "marts.marketo__operational_health_simple.daily_summary",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "AVG(daily_emails_sent) FILTER(WHERE activity_date>=CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL 6 DAY)",
      "alternative": "The contract says \"within the last 7 days\" without specifying whether this means today plus six dates or the preceding seven completed dates.",
      "importance": 2,
      "reason": "Different window boundaries can change all three recent trend averages.",
      "updates": null
    }
  ],
  "fewer": []
}
